response.en: 🍽️ We have comfortable air-conditioned indoor seating, an outdoor dining area, and clean restrooms. Both dine-in and takeaway are available. Phone charging points are provided for your convenience! 😊

response.en: 💳 You can pay by cash or scan our DuitNow QR code at the counter. We accept Touch 'n Go, Boost, ShopeePay, and GrabPay. Just let our staff know! 😊
response.ms: 💳 Anda boleh bayar secara tunai atau imbas kod DuitNow QR di kaunter. Kami terima Touch 'n Go, Boost, ShopeePay, dan GrabPay. Beritahu staf kami! 😊
response.zh: 💳 您可以用现金或扫描柜台的 DuitNow QR 码付款。我们接受 Touch 'n Go、Boost、ShopeePay 和 GrabPay。告诉我们的员工即可！😊

response.en:
⚠️ *Allergen & Dietary Info*

Please inform our staff of any food allergies or dietary requirements before ordering.

You can also ask me about a specific dish — just say 'tell me about [item name]' and I'll include any allergen information we have on file.
response.ms:
⚠️ *Maklumat Alergen & Pemakanan*

Sila maklumkan kepada staf kami mengenai sebarang alahan makanan atau keperluan pemakanan sebelum membuat pesanan.

Anda juga boleh tanya saya tentang hidangan tertentu — cakap saja 'cerita pasal [nama item]' dan saya akan sertakan maklumat alergen yang ada.
response.zh:
⚠️ *过敏原与饮食信息*

点餐前请告知我们的工作人员您的食物过敏或饮食要求。

您也可以询问我特定菜肴的过敏原信息 — 只需说"告诉我关于[菜品名称]"，我会提供相关信息。

response.en: 📶 We don't currently offer guest WiFi at Makan Moments Cafe. But come enjoy our cozy atmosphere and delicious food — we promise it's worth the visit! 😊
response.ms: 📶 Buat masa ini kami tidak menyediakan WiFi tetamu di Makan Moments Cafe. Tapi jom nikmati suasana selesa dan makanan sedap kami — memang berbaloi! 😊
response.zh: 📶 目前 Makan Moments Cafe 暂未提供客人WiFi。但欢迎来享受我们舒适的氛围和美味的食物——绝对值得！😊

response.en:
🍽️ *How to Order*

1. Walk in — no reservation needed!
2. Find a seat (indoor or outdoor)
3. Check the menu at your table or ask our staff
4. Order at the counter or tell our staff
5. Pay when your order is ready

Dine-in and takeaway both available. Enjoy your meal! 😊
response.ms:
🍽️ *Cara Memesan*

1. Masuk je — tak perlu tempah!
2. Cari tempat duduk (dalam atau luar)
3. Tengok menu di meja atau tanya staf
4. Pesan di kaunter atau beritahu staf
5. Bayar bila pesanan siap

Makan di sini dan bungkus tersedia. Selamat menjamu selera! 😊
response.zh:
🍽️ *如何点餐*

1. 直接来——不需要预约！
2. 找个座位（室内或室外）
3. 查看桌上菜单或询问员工
4. 在柜台点餐或告诉员工
5. 取餐时付款

堂食和打包均可。祝您用餐愉快！😊

response.en:
💳 *Ready to Pay?*

Just head to the counter when you're done! We accept cash, DuitNow QR, and e-wallets (Touch 'n Go, Boost, ShopeePay, GrabPay).

Thank you for dining at Makan Moments! 😊
response.ms:
💳 *Nak Bayar?*

Pergi ke kaunter bila dah siap makan! Kami terima tunai, DuitNow QR, dan e-wallet (Touch 'n Go, Boost, ShopeePay, GrabPay).

Terima kasih kerana makan di Makan Moments! 😊
response.zh:
💳 *要付款了？*

用完餐到柜台付款即可！我们接受现金、DuitNow QR 和电子钱包（Touch 'n Go、Boost、ShopeePay、GrabPay）。

感谢您在 Makan Moments 用餐！😊

response.en: 💳 Simply pay at the counter when you're ready. We accept cash, DuitNow QR, and all major e-wallets. Thank you for visiting Makan Moments Cafe! 😊
response.ms: 💳 Bayar saja di kaunter bila dah siap. Kami terima tunai, DuitNow QR, dan semua e-wallet utama. Terima kasih kerana datang Makan Moments Cafe! 😊
response.zh: 💳 准备好时在柜台付款即可。我们接受现金、DuitNow QR 和所有主要电子钱包。感谢光临 Makan Moments Cafe！😊

response.en:
📋 *Cafe Guidelines*

1. Please order at the counter
2. No outside food or drinks
3. Keep the dining area clean
4. No smoking inside the cafe
5. Please bus your own table after eating

Thank you for helping us keep Makan Moments a pleasant space for everyone! 😊
response.ms:
📋 *Panduan Kafe*

1. Sila pesan di kaunter
2. Tiada makanan atau minuman dari luar
3. Jaga kebersihan kawasan makan
4. Dilarang merokok di dalam kafe
5. Sila kemas meja anda selepas makan

Terima kasih kerana membantu kami menjadikan Makan Moments tempat yang selesa untuk semua! 😊
response.zh:
📋 *咖啡厅守则*

1. 请在柜台点餐
2. 请勿携带外食
3. 请保持用餐区整洁
4. 咖啡厅内禁止吸烟
5. 用餐后请自行清理桌面

感谢您帮助我们维护 Makan Moments 的舒适环境！😊

response.en: 📋 Our cafe has a few simple guidelines: no outside food, no smoking indoors, and please clean up your table after eating. Thank you for your cooperation! 😊
response.ms: 📋 Kafe kami ada beberapa panduan mudah: tiada makanan luar, dilarang merokok di dalam, dan sila kemas meja selepas makan. Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda! 😊
response.zh: 📋 我们咖啡厅有几条简单规则：不带外食、室内禁烟、用餐后请清理桌面。感谢您的配合！😊

response.en: Thank you so much for your kind words! 😊 We truly appreciate your feedback and are glad you enjoyed your meal at Makan Moments Cafe. Your support means a lot to us! We look forward to serving you again. 😊
response.ms: Terima kasih banyak atas kata-kata baik anda! 😊 Kami sangat menghargai maklum balas anda dan gembira anda menikmati hidangan di Makan Moments Cafe. Sokongan anda sangat bermakna! Kami nantikan kedatangan anda lagi. 😊
response.zh: 非常感谢您的好评！😊 我们真心感谢您的反馈，很高兴您在 Makan Moments Cafe 用餐愉快。您的支持对我们意义重大！期待再次为您服务。😊

response.en: Thank you for sharing your feedback! We truly appreciate it and always strive to improve. If anything wasn't up to standard, we're sorry and want to make it right. Please don't hesitate to let our staff know how we can do better! 😊
response.ms: Terima kasih kerana berkongsi maklum balas! Kami sangat menghargai dan sentiasa berusaha untuk menambah baik. Jika ada apa-apa yang tidak memuaskan, kami minta maaf dan ingin memperbaikinya. Sila beritahu staf kami! 😊
response.zh: 感谢您分享反馈！我们真心感谢并始终努力改进。如有任何不满意，我们深感抱歉并希望改善。请告诉我们的员工如何做得更好！😊

response.en: I'm sorry to hear that. Please bring your receipt to the counter and our staff will review the charges and resolve any discrepancies right away. 😊
response.ms: Maaf mendengar itu. Sila bawa resit ke kaunter dan staf kami akan semak caj dan selesaikan sebarang masalah segera. 😊
response.zh: 很抱歉听到这个问题。请将收据带到柜台，我们的员工会立即审查费用并解决问题。😊

response.en:
💳 *Billing Question?*

Please bring your receipt to the counter and our staff will be happy to clarify any charges. We want to make sure everything is correct! 😊
response.ms:
💳 *Soalan Bil?*

Sila bawa resit ke kaunter dan staf kami akan jelaskan sebarang caj. Kami nak pastikan semuanya betul! 😊
response.zh:
💳 *账单问题？*

请将收据带到柜台，我们的员工会乐意为您解释任何费用。我们要确保一切正确！😊

response.en:
📦 *Lost Something?*

If you left an item at the cafe, please come back as soon as possible or contact our staff. We keep found items for up to 7 days.

Describe what you lost and approximately when you were here, and we'll do our best to help! 😊
response.ms:
📦 *Tertinggal Barang?*

Jika anda tertinggal barang di kafe, sila datang balik secepat mungkin atau hubungi staf kami. Kami simpan barang jumpa selama 7 hari.

Terangkan barang yang hilang dan lebih kurang bila anda di sini, kami akan cuba bantu! 😊
response.zh:
📦 *落下东西了？*

如果您在咖啡厅遗失了物品，请尽快回来或联系我们的员工。我们保留发现的物品最多7天。

描述您丢失的物品和大约的用餐时间，我们会尽力帮助！😊

response.en: Of course! Need extra napkins, utensils, or condiments? Just ask our staff at the counter and we'll bring them to your table right away! 😊
response.ms: Tentu! Perlukan tisu tambahan, sudu garpu, atau sos? Tanya staf kami di kaunter dan kami akan bawakan ke meja anda segera! 😊
response.zh: 当然可以！需要额外的纸巾、餐具或调料？在柜台告诉我们的员工，我们会马上送到您的桌子！😊

response.en:
🍽️ *Cafe Layout*

Our counter is at the front — order and pay there. Seating is available indoors (air-conditioned) and outdoors. Restrooms are at the back of the cafe. Need help finding anything? Just ask our staff! 😊
response.ms:
🍽️ *Susun Atur Kafe*

Kaunter kami di hadapan — pesan dan bayar di situ. Tempat duduk ada di dalam (ber-AC) dan luar. Tandas di belakang kafe. Perlukan bantuan? Tanya staf kami! 😊
response.zh:
🍽️ *咖啡厅布局*

柜台在前面——在那里点餐和付款。室内（有空调）和室外都有座位。洗手间在咖啡厅后面。需要帮忙找什么？问我们的员工！😊

response.en: We're sorry about the temperature! Please let our staff know and we'll adjust the air-conditioning. You can also choose to sit in our outdoor area if you prefer. 😊
response.ms: Maaf tentang suhu! Sila maklumkan staf kami dan kami akan laraskan penyaman udara. Anda juga boleh duduk di kawasan luar jika mahu. 😊
response.zh: 抱歉温度不合适！请告知我们的员工，我们会调整空调。您也可以选择在室外区域用餐。😊

response.en:
🏪 *Nearby Services*

Our cafe is conveniently located near shops, banks, and public transport. Ask our staff for specific directions to nearby ATMs, pharmacies, or convenience stores — we're happy to help! 😊
response.ms:
🏪 *Perkhidmatan Berdekatan*

Kafe kami terletak berhampiran kedai, bank, dan pengangkutan awam. Tanya staf kami untuk arah ke ATM, farmasi, atau kedai serbaneka berdekatan — kami gembira membantu! 😊
response.zh:
🏪 *附近服务*

我们的咖啡厅附近有商店、银行和公共交通。询问我们的员工附近的ATM、药房或便利店的方向——我们很乐意帮忙！😊

response.en:
♿ *Accessibility*

Our cafe is on the ground floor with step-free access to the main dining area. If you have any special requirements, please let our staff know and we'll do our best to accommodate you! 😊
response.ms:
♿ *Aksesibiliti*

Kafe kami di tingkat bawah dengan akses tanpa tangga ke kawasan makan utama. Jika ada keperluan khas, sila maklumkan staf kami dan kami akan cuba sebaik mungkin! 😊
response.zh:
♿ *无障碍信息*

我们的咖啡厅在一楼，主要用餐区无台阶。如有特殊需求，请告知我们的员工，我们会尽力满足！😊

response.en: We don't have a dedicated luggage storage area, but if you have a bag while dining, our staff can help find a safe spot near your table. Just let us know! 😊
response.ms: Kami tidak ada ruang simpanan bagasi khas, tetapi jika anda ada beg semasa makan, staf kami boleh bantu cari tempat selamat berhampiran meja anda. Beritahu kami! 😊
response.zh: 我们没有专门的行李存放处，但如果您用餐时有行李，我们的员工可以帮您在桌旁找个安全的地方。告诉我们就好！😊

response.en: You're welcome to stay and enjoy the cafe atmosphere as long as you like! Feel free to order another round of drinks or snacks. 😊
response.ms: Anda dialu-alukan untuk duduk dan nikmati suasana kafe selama mana anda mahu! Jangan segan untuk pesan minuman atau snek lagi. 😊
response.zh: 欢迎您在咖啡厅多坐一会儿！随时再点一杯饮料或小食。😊

response.en: We have various seating options — indoor air-conditioned tables, outdoor seating, and counter seats. Let our staff know your preference and we'll find the best spot for you! 😊
response.ms: Kami ada pelbagai pilihan tempat duduk — meja dalam ber-AC, tempat duduk luar, dan kerusi kaunter. Beritahu staf pilihan anda dan kami akan carikan tempat terbaik! 😊
response.zh: 我们有多种座位选择——室内空调桌、室外座位和吧台座位。告诉员工您的喜好，我们会为您找到最佳位置！😊

response.en: ⏰ Our cafe is open until 10:00 PM for dinner service. Last order is 30 minutes before closing. You're welcome to stay and enjoy until closing time! 😊
response.ms: ⏰ Kafe kami buka hingga 10:00 MLM untuk makan malam. Pesanan terakhir 30 minit sebelum tutup. Anda dialu-alukan untuk duduk dan nikmati sehingga tutup! 😊
response.zh: ⏰ 我们咖啡厅晚餐营业到晚上10:00。最后点餐时间为关门前30分钟。欢迎您在这里享受到打烊！😊

response.en: No problem! I've cancelled that. Is there anything else I can help you with? 😊
response.ms: Tiada masalah! Saya dah batalkan. Ada apa-apa lain saya boleh bantu? 😊
response.zh: 没问题！已取消。还有什么我可以帮忙的吗？😊

response.en: I'm not sure I understand. Could you rephrase your question? You can ask me about our menu, operating hours, specials, or directions to the cafe! 😊
response.ms: Maaf, saya tidak faham. Boleh tulis semula soalan anda? Anda boleh tanya tentang menu, waktu operasi, spesial, atau arah ke kafe! 😊
